components.name: Relation-conditioned witness precision for radical-support collapse
components.project_addition: Use radical as an explicit finite multiplicative-support collapse; expose the forgotten multiplicity residual with exact integer coordinates; separate witness search radius from arithmetic absorption redundancy; compress the resulting two-cost certificate language by a Pareto frontier; derive the exact absorption floor from a scaled exterior/determinantal signature and then directly from support blocks plus valuation exponents; resolve that floor into prime-local obstruction coordinates, including obstructions contributed by prime factors of valuation exponents outside rad(abc); and compare these certificate summaries with P023 task-relative precision and A4 antichain semantics. The project does not claim the underlying radical, Mason-Stothers, arithmetic-derivative, Wronskian, Smith/determinantal-divisor, exterior-algebra, Pareto/Dickson, derivation-generalization, or exceptional-set mathematics.
